statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and dizziness
There is concern for paroxysmal supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
Cardiac event monitoring (CPT 93271) is medically necessary
The service is to correlate symptoms with potential arrhythmic events
The claim was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial reason is that care may be covered by another payer in accordance with coordination of benefits protocols
